title: 第十五章 当代课老师第十七章 暴雨中的炎帝 T
content_zh:
“同学们好，这位就是今天的代课老师，大家要专心听课，别辜负了老师的期望知道吗？”优藤校长拉着林萧对初级班的学生进行介绍。
此时的林萧已经是骑虎难下了，就算前面是万丈深渊也只能闭着眼睛跳下去了。
林萧站直身体让自己尽量体现得像一位老师，微笑道：“同学们好，我是今天的代课老师，我叫林萧，负责教导大家今天的课程。”
不过这一群聚集了关东最有钱的少爷、公主们可不买账。林萧话刚落音反对者就随之出现。
一名留着长发的小孩还立马问道：“校长，这家伙看起来不比我们大多少啊，他凭什么教我们？”
“就是，那里来的无名小卒，也敢来糊弄我们。”
“滚出去，我们这里不欢迎你！”
“就是，滚出去！我们交了钱是来学习知识的，不是来看你这个乡下人的。”
优藤校长，对林萧耸耸肩示意，你自己搞定，我可帮不了你。这让林萧很无奈，这老头明显的把自己给卖了，卖了不说还得帮他擦屁股。
望着吵闹的学生，趴在窗子上偷看的芽衣不安的悄悄问道：“圣代，你说林萧这样能行吗？我怕他等会会被这些学生打出来。”
不说芽衣，就是圣代自己也感到不安，但还是轻声对芽衣说道：“应该没问题的，大叔可是很厉害的，我们看下去不就知道了？”
两人对视一眼，继续趴在窗子上看林萧怎么收拾烂摊子。
林萧被这群七吵八闹的学生吵得头晕脑胀，一怒之下双手猛然拍向讲桌。
“都他娘的给老子闭嘴！”
寂静~教室里所以的声音都消失了，这时候就算丢根针下来都能听得到。
深深的吸了几口气，林萧指着那些吵闹的学生大声道：“看什么看？说的就是你，家里有钱了不起？你tama的有种不依靠家里的资助到外面过一星期给老子看？呸！有几个臭钱拽什么拽！”
“还有你，你说老子没有资格教你们？”
“老子一个人给几百只小精灵做小精灵食物的时候你们不知道还在哪里撒尿玩泥巴，你在我面前谈资格？你他娘的毛长齐了没有？”
“你！！少跟我扯些饲育家徽章的闲话，老子告诉你，我没有那玩意！老子在大木研究所做了五年的助理，一直都是一个人照顾几百只神奇宝贝。你们眼里的饲育家徽章在我眼里一文不值。”
“现在，有话的就快说，有屁就快放！”

还是寂静~
这群娇生惯养的少爷、小姐们哪见过这种场面，直接被林萧的彪悍给震住了，愣愣的你看看我，我看看你，愣是没有人在发话、反对。
惊讶得一张小嘴都快何不拢的芽衣，轻轻碰了下身旁的圣代，“圣代，你们的老师都是这样教你们的吗？你确定这是在上课，不是在骂街?”
“呸！”圣代轻呸一口，脸色微红，愤怒回道：“怎么可能！我们这是最优秀的学院，可不是那种乡下下三流的地方，骗子大叔发什么疯？哪有这样教学生的。”
环视一圈，少爷、小姐都没有吭声，林萧满意的点点，拍拍手把学生们的视线集中过来。
“既然大家都没有意见，那么现在开始上课。”
“首先我问你们，为什么想要做小精灵饲育家？”
教师里很安静，似乎没有人想要回答林萧的问题。
就在林萧准备接着讲的时候，一只小手举了起来。
小手的主人是个jiaoxiao的小男生孩，在林萧的眼神注视下有些胆怯的道：“老。。。老师，我想成为饲育家，是因为，因为。。。。”
“碰！”的一声巨响，直接把小男孩的话吓得缩了回去。
“你叫什么名字？”林萧严肃的看着发言的小男孩问道。
小男孩似乎被林萧吓到了，结结巴巴的说：“我叫。。。。我叫小生。”
“哎~”林萧失望的拍拍小生的肩膀，“虽然说你还小，但是大小也还是个男人啊，怎么能像女人一样说话细声娇气的。既然是个男人就应该把男人的气魄展现出来。”
“告诉我，你是不是男人！！！”
在林萧的刺激下，小生握紧拳头喊道：“我是男人！”
content_en:
"Hello, classmates, this is today's substitute teacher. Everyone should pay attention to the class and don't let down the teacher's expectations, okay?" Principal Yuto took Lin Xiao to introduce the students in the junior class.
At this time, Lin Xiao was already riding a tiger and couldn't get out. Even if there was an abyss in front of him, he could only jump in with his eyes closed.
Lin Xiao stood up straight and tried to behave like a teacher, and said with a smile: "Hello, students, I am today's substitute teacher. My name is Lin Xiao, and I am responsible for teaching everyone today's course."
However, this group of richest young masters and princesses in Kanto didn't buy it. As soon as Lin Xiao finished speaking, opponents appeared.
A child with long hair immediately asked: "Principal, this guy doesn't look much older than us. Why does he teach us?"
"Even the unknown people from there dare to fool us."
"Get out, you are not welcome here!"
"That's right, get out! We paid money to learn knowledge, not to see you, a country boy."
Principal Yuto shrugged at Lin Xiao and said, "You can handle it yourself, I can't help you." This made Lin Xiao very helpless. The old man had obviously sold himself out. Even if he sold himself out, he still had to wipe his ass.
Looking at the noisy students, Mei Yi, who was leaning on the window to peek, asked uneasily: "Sundae, do you think Lin Xiao can do this? I'm afraid he will be beaten out by these students later."
Not to mention Mei Yi, even Sundae himself felt uneasy, but he still said softly to Mei Yi: "It should be fine, uncle is very powerful, won't we know after watching?"
The two looked at each other and continued to lean on the window to watch Lin Xiao clean up the mess.
Lin Xiao was so noisy by the noisy students that he felt dizzy. In anger, he slammed his hands on the desk.
"Shut the hell up!"
Silence~ All the sounds in the classroom have disappeared. At this time, you can hear it even if you drop a pin.
After taking a few deep breaths, Lin Xiao pointed at the noisy students and said loudly: "What are you looking at? I'm talking about you. It's great to have money at home? How dare you go out for a week without relying on family funds to show me? Bah! What are you doing with a few stinky rich people!"
"And you, are you saying that I am not qualified to teach you?"
"When I was making elf food for hundreds of elves by myself, you were peeing and playing in the mud. Are you talking about your qualifications in front of me? Have you even grown all your fucking fur?"
"You!! Stop talking to me about the breeder badge. I tell you, I don't have that thing! I have been an assistant at the Oak Research Institute for five years, and I have always taken care of hundreds of Pokémon by myself. The breeder badge in your eyes is worthless in my eyes."
"Now, if you have something to say, say it quickly, and if you have a fart, say it quickly!"
Still silent~
This group of pampered young masters and young ladies had never seen such a scene before. They were directly shocked by Lin Xiao's toughness. You looked at me and I looked at you, but no one spoke or objected.
Mei Yi, who was so surprised that her mouth almost closed, gently touched the sundae next to her, "Sundae, is this how your teacher teaches you? Are you sure this is a lesson and not a scolding?"
"Bah!" Sundae took a sip, his face turned red, and he replied angrily: "How is that possible! We are the best college, not a third-rate place in the countryside. Why is uncle Liar so crazy? How can anyone teach students like this?"
Looking around, neither the young master nor the young lady made a sound. Lin Xiao nodded with satisfaction and clapped his hands to focus the attention of the students.
"Since everyone has no objections, let's start class now."
"First of all, let me ask you, why do you want to be an elf breeder?"
The teacher was very quiet, and no one seemed to want to answer Lin Xiao's question.
Just when Lin Xiao was about to continue speaking, a small hand was raised.
Lord of little handsThe person was a jiaoxiao little boy. Under Lin Xiao's gaze, he said timidly: "Old...teacher, I want to become a breeder because, because..."
A loud sound of "touch!" made the little boy shrink back in fear.
"What's your name?" Lin Xiao asked seriously looking at the little boy who spoke.
The little boy seemed to be frightened by Lin Xiao and stammered: "My name is... My name is Xiaosheng."
"Hey~" Lin Xiao patted Xiaosheng on the shoulder in disappointment, "Although you are still young, you are still a man. How can you speak softly and delicately like a woman? Since you are a man, you should show your manliness."
"Tell me if you are a man!!!"
Under Lin Xiao's stimulation, Xiaosheng clenched his fists and shouted: "I am a man!"
